# WZ Reader

> A free document viewer for PDF, Korean HWP/HWPX, Word, PowerPoint, Excel,
> e-mail (.eml), Markdown and images. It runs entirely on the user's device —
> in the browser or as a Windows desktop app — with no backend and no file
> upload. Called WZ PDF until version 1.25.

WZ Reader runs as a web app and as a Windows desktop app (Electron). The UI is
available in English and Korean (auto-detected from the browser/OS locale; can
be forced with `?lang=en` or `?lang=ko`).

## Key features

- Formats: PDF, HWP/HWPX (Korean word processor, with native selectable text),
  Word (.docx), PowerPoint (.pptx), spreadsheets (.xlsx .xlsm .xls .ods .csv,
  every row of very large sheets), e-mail (.eml with attachments and Korean
  encodings), Markdown (rendered, and editable), images.
- Save as PDF from any of these formats, with selectable text. HWP → PDF keeps
  a real text layer; HWP ⇄ HWPX conversion from the command line.
- Present: single, two-page, grid and fullscreen views; ZoomIt-style presenter
  tools (pen, highlighter, arrow, laser pointer, spotlight zoom); a deck's
  speaker notes shown under each slide and as captions in the slideshow.
- Read aloud (desktop): an on-device voice (Supertonic 3, Korean included)
  reads the document or a deck's speaker notes, highlights the sentence, and
  turns the pages in a presentation. A deck with notes can be saved as a
  narrated MP4 with a switchable subtitle track.
- OCR: on-device Korean + English text recognition (PaddleOCR); recognized text
  is saved into the PDF. Ctrl-drag a region to copy its text.
- Annotate: stamps (saved, background removed, pasted onto many pages at once),
  hand-drawn signatures, watermarks, text edits, undo/redo.
- PDF: password-protected PDFs (open, lock with AES-256, unlock), page reorder /
  insert / delete, save selected pages, booklet (two pages per sheet), PDFs over
  500 MB (desktop).
- Export: PDF, a self-contained HTML viewer, page images (ZIP), and a
  standalone Viewer EXE (desktop).
- Embed: `app.html?embed=1&url=…` puts a read-only viewer in any web page;
  private mode (`private.json` beside `app.html`) shows only the documents a
  server designates, view only.
- Desktop app: file associations, batch converters on PATH (`topdf`, `hwp2pdf`,
  `hwp2hwpx`, `hwpx2hwp`), an MCP server for AI agents, automatic updates.
- Privacy: no server, no upload. All processing happens on the user's device.

## Technology

React, Konva, pdf.js, @cantoo/pdf-lib, @rhwp/core (Rust → WebAssembly),
docx-preview, pptx-renderer, hucre, onnxruntime (OCR and speech), WebCodecs +
mediabunny (video), and Electron (desktop). A Model Context Protocol (MCP)
server lets AI agents read every supported format and convert it to PDF.
